I've had mine for 4 years and I have some let down's in regard to the cleanup of the grill. Unfortunately, from my experience, those flavor bars are a not to my liking.  Everything gets covered in grease, and it just drives me crazy with having to clean them about every 
 other time, with a full clean job.  I only use the spray cleaner at those times.  I do clean the  grills, which aren't all that hard to keep clean.  I had one of the wheel caps break off while transporting from the pickup to its siting place on my porch.  The wheels were not made to be pushed or pulled on the lawn. They did replace it.  The burners work fine, but like the flavor bars, they get soaked in grease as well.  The propane tank attachment is okay, along with the hose and connector.     Other than the cleaning part, I would give it an " A grade"

Results.ReviewText: This grill has thus far lived up to the expectations I had when I purchased it. It took some time to assemble, but the directions were clear and no parts were missing. The grill is easy enough to move on paved surfaces, which was important to me as I keep it in the garage nightly. Having mostly used charcoal grills in the past, I was delighted to discover how quickly this grill lights and preheats, reaching nearly 600 degrees in less than 10 minutes with both burners on. This makes searing meat a snap, and leaves the meat juicy while also reducing cooking time. Oh, and it also leaves the meat with nice grill marks. Who doesn't like that? Finally, the cooking grills clean up very easily with a decent grill brush (not included), and they are also easy to remove when you want to do a deeper cleaning.
Results.Title: Weber Quality

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
